# socai documentation

> socai is a local agent that researches Xiaohongshu, Douyin, TikTok, Instagram, and LinkedIn through a signed-in Chrome session and returns source-linked evidence.

## Start here

- [Documentation overview](https://socai.io/docs/)
- [Quickstart](https://socai.io/docs/quickstart/)
- [Installation](https://socai.io/docs/installation/)
- [Connect Chrome](https://socai.io/docs/browser-connection/)

## Use socai

- [Agent workflows](https://socai.io/docs/agent-workflows/)
- [CLI reference](https://socai.io/docs/cli/)
- [Supported platforms](https://socai.io/docs/platforms/)
- [Evidence and artifacts](https://socai.io/docs/evidence/)
